name: Number Guess
description: Reference world: find a hidden number using a probe tool, in as few steps as possible.

skills.name: number-guess
skills.description: Find a hidden number by probing.
skills.workflow:
Number Guess — you are helping the user find a hidden number. Use the tools available to you to narrow down the range, then commit to an answer. Aim to find it in as few probe steps as possible.

Call compare to test a number and learn whether the target is higher or lower. When you are sure, call submit_answer with the number as your answer. submit_answer ends the episode, so do not call it until you have narrowed the range.

rubrics.title: Efficient solve
rubrics.criteria: Did the assistant find the hidden number, and how few steps did it take?

rubrics.title: Probe before commit
rubrics.criteria: Did the assistant narrow the range with probes before committing to an answer?

tools.description: Probe whether the hidden target is higher than, lower than, or equal to a number.

number.description: Number to compare the target against.

train.user_query: Find the hidden number between 1 and 10.
I picked a number from 1 to 10. Which one is it?
Work out my secret number, somewhere in 1-10.
Guess the number I am thinking of between 1 and 10.
There is a hidden number in 1-10. Track it down.
Can you figure out my number? It is between 1 and 10.
Identify the hidden value in the range 1 to 10.
Tell me the number I chose from 1 to 10.
My number sits between 1 and 10. Name it.
Narrow down and tell me my number in 1-10.
What number between 1 and 10 am I hiding?
Pin down my hidden number, 1 through 10.
